commit.message:
6988055: Update java.net.IDN to UTS#46 and merge parts of ICU.

With this change, the static functions in java.net.IDN match the DNS
usage in the big three web browsers, Go, PHP etc. The javadoc has been
extended somewhat, since a competent java developer will often need a
little text to understand the finer details here, and the URLs updated.

The ICU merge includes what's needed to make UTS#46 work, with the
smallest reasonable diff. An old IDNA2003-related file has been removed
and various IDNA2003-related code was purged in the merge. Some ICU
code that's only necessary for registries, not for UTS#46, was not
merged. A typo in ICU's Punycode.isBasicUpperCase() has been fixed.

There are three new static public constants.
